page_notes: Page 180 (PIR page 164) contains one entry (851) explicitly matching the criteria for the PROVINCIA corpus (legatus Augusti pro praetore of Cappadocia). Entry 849 mentions 'legatus pr. pr. provinciae Africae', which is a legatus proconsulis, not a legatus Augusti pro praetore, and is excluded. No other entries on this page explicitly attest a legatus Augusti pro praetore.
